description.en: MCP tools that turn public plant-omics database APIs into interfaces an LLM can call reliably.
description.zh: 把国内植物组学数据库的公开接口做成一套 AI 可直接调用的 MCP 工具。

description.en: 7 plant-omics databases behind 34 MCP tools: wheat, rice, maize, strawberry, sugarcane and more. Thin plugin plus a remote MCP service; outputs carry full provenance.
description.zh: 7 个植物组学数据库、34 个 MCP 工具，覆盖小麦、水稻、玉米、草莓、甘蔗等。薄插件 + 远程 MCP 服务，输出带完整出处尾注。
